source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), pick one enemy unit after this model shoots, provided an attack from the model hit it at least one time. Deny that unit the **[Benefit of Cover](vsdata:core-rule/benefit-of-cover)** for the rest of the phase.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.effect: target cannot receive Benefit of Cover
